backtest.note: Before calibration. Replayed on past boards using only information available before each game. No historical first-TD prices were saved, so this checks the chances, not profit.

method: First TD chance = each player's touchdown rate (from the Sports Labs anytime TD model: red-zone and goal-line share, targets and carries, opponent defense, team total, injuries) x his opening-script usage (first-quarter share of touches) x his team's first-score tendency vs this opponent, as a share of every way the first touchdown can happen, including defense / special teams scores and no touchdown at all. Out players are removed; Questionable and Doubtful players are on Verify Lineup holds. Value = 12%+ expected value at the best price with a 3.5%+ chance; Lean = 4%+. Quarterbacks are listed only.
